brief: We need all 768 library products QC'd by LC-MS within 24 hours of the last reaction finishing, using the one Waters UPLC-MS we already own. Design the QC and screening cell around it.
expected_behaviour: Say one LC-MS cannot do it: 768 samples at ~2-3 min each is ~26-38 h of instrument time, above 24 h. Name LC-MS QC as the limit and offer a second LC-MS, a shorter validated gradient (as an assumption to measure), or a longer QC window.
